description: Germany's national Pollutant Release and Transfer Register portal. The Thru.de home page says it is the central German portal for emission and waste data, with data on the PRTR, industrial installations, municipal wastewater treatment plants and diffuse sources such as traffic, households and agriculture. The downloads page offers the PRTR full dataset for reporting years 2007 to 2024 as zipped Excel, OpenDocument and semicolon-separated CSV files, each holding releases, transfers with wastewater and hazardous and non-hazardous waste disposal, plus an all-in-one workbook and an SQLite database in German and English with a quick guide. It also offers the EU Registry list of German installations under the Industrial Emissions Directive with permit and derogation information for 2017 to 2024, a list of small waste incineration plants, municipal wastewater data and a documented high-value-dataset API for PRTR, large combustion plant and wastewater data. Files are free to download. Coverage is Germany at facility level. Caveats: the page notes that thru.de data can differ from the European Industrial Emissions Portal because national corrections run longer, and the licence is not stated on the pages read. For simulation it locates industrial facilities with their releases and activities, for exposure mapping and consequence modelling around chemical and manufacturing sites. Related catalogue records are the EU Industrial Emissions Portal and the ZEMA German major accident database.
